---
title: Examples for S3SLSTRL2
---

The requests below are written in python. To execute them you need to
create an OAuth client as explained
[here](/APIs/SentinelHub/Overview/Authentication.qmd#python). It is
named `oauth` in these examples.

## Land Surface Temperature (LST) visualized

```python
evalscript = """
//VERSION=3
function setup() {
  return {
    input: ["LST"],
    output: {
      bands: 3,
    },
  }
}

// Red temperature gradient, in kelvin
var viz = ColorGradientVisualizer.createRedTemperature(250, 330)

function evaluatePixel(sample) {
  return viz.process(sample.LST)
}
"""

request = {
    "input": {
        "bounds": {
            "bbox": [8.958382, 42.059678, 9.379525, 42.615688],
        },
        "data": [
            {
                "type": "sentinel-3-slstr-l2",
                "dataFilter": {
                    "timeRange": {
                        "from": "2024-04-04T00:00:00Z",
                        "to": "2024-04-04T23:59:59Z",
                    },
                },
            }
        ],
    },
    "output": {
        "width": 512,
        "height": 512,
        "responses": [
            {
                "identifier": "default",
                "format": {"type": "image/png"},
            }
        ],
    },
    "evalscript": evalscript,
}

url = "https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/process/v1"

response = oauth.post(url, json=request)
```

## Urban Heat Island Visualizer

```python
evalscript = """
//VERSION=3

function setup() {
  return {
    input: ["LST", "dataMask"],
    output: { bands: 4 }
  };
}

const colorRamp = [
  [293.15, 0x0000ff], // 20.0°C - Blue
  [300.65, 0x00ffff], // 27.5°C - Cyan
  [308.15, 0xffff00], // 35.0°C - Yellow
  [315.65, 0xff8800], // 42.5°C - Orange
  [323.15, 0xff0000]  // 50.0°C - Red
];;

const visualizer = new ColorRampVisualizer(colorRamp);

function evaluatePixel(sample) {
  // Return transparent pixels for nodata
  if (sample.dataMask === 0 || sample.LST === 0) {
    return [0, 0, 0, 0];
  }

  let rgb = visualizer.process(sample.LST);
  return rgb.concat(sample.dataMask);
}
"""

request = {
    "input": {
        "bounds": {
            "bbox": [1.842957, 48.621666, 2.817993, 49.066434],
        },
        "data": [
            {
                "type": "sentinel-3-slstr-l2",
                "dataFilter": {
                    "timeRange": {
                        "from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
                        "to": "2026-08-02T23:59:59Z",
                    },
                },
            }
        ],
    },
    "output": {
        "width": 512,
        "height": 512,
        "responses": [
            {
                "identifier": "default",
                "format": {"type": "image/png"},
            }
        ],
    },
    "evalscript": evalscript,
}

url = "https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/process/v1"

response = oauth.post(url, json=request)
```

## All L2 bands as a multi-band GeoTIFF (EPSG 32632)

This example exports all the bands supported for Sentinel-3 SLSTR L2 —
`LST`, `LST_uncertainty`, `NDVI`, `CLOUD`, `BAYES`, `POINTING` and
`CONFIDENCE` — as a seven-band, single-precision GeoTIFF reprojected to
UTM zone 32N.

```python
evalscript = """
//VERSION=3
function setup() {
  return {
    input: ["LST", "LST_uncertainty", "NDVI", "CLOUD", "BAYES", "POINTING", "CONFIDENCE"],
    output: {
      bands: 7,
      sampleType: "FLOAT32",
    },
  }
}

function evaluatePixel(sample) {
  return [
    sample.LST,
    sample.LST_uncertainty,
    sample.NDVI,
    sample.CLOUD,
    sample.BAYES,
    sample.POINTING,
    sample.CONFIDENCE,
  ]
}
"""

request = {
    "input": {
        "bounds": {
            "bbox": [8.558382, 41.359678, 9.579525, 43.055688],
            "properties": {"crs": "http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326"},
        },
        "data": [
            {
                "type": "sentinel-3-slstr-l2",
                "dataFilter": {
                    "timeRange": {
                        "from": "2024-04-04T00:00:00Z",
                        "to": "2024-04-04T23:59:59Z",
                    },
                },
            }
        ],
    },
    "output": {
        "width": 512,
        "height": 512,
        "responses": [
            {
                "identifier": "default",
                "format": {"type": "image/tiff"},
            }
        ],
    },
    "evalscript": evalscript,
}

url = "https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/process/v1"

response = oauth.post(url, json=request)
```
